gpu: NVIDIA B200 (one card of a GB200 node)
calibre: server end to end: 1e6 * B / decode tok/s (client clock over HTTP, prompt 64, 1024 new tokens, greedy, 5 repeats). These are TRIAL numbers, measured in other pods than the engine under test, which is timed in its own process (step, no sampling, no HTTP): the easier calibre. A speedup here is an upper bound on the end-to-end one until both are measured on one card by one client (scripts/compare.sh).
